Resolves #20393

The AnimateRows destruction test passed its body, then failed because cleanup asked the already-destroyed grid for another owned timeout. Skip that cleanup wait once the grid is destroyed, and run this Node-only spec in CI by removing its obsolete browser exclusion. Runtime cancellation and genuine-error assertions remain intact.

Evidence: L2 (executable lifecycle specs, including CI-mode invocation) → L2 required. No residuals.

Micro-review eligible: test-only repair — one teardown guard and removal of an obsolete skip; no runtime delta.

## AC Evidence
| AC | Evidence |
|---|---|
| AC-1 | CI-covered: all eight cases in `test/playwright/unit/grid/AnimateRowsSteps.spec.mjs`, including destruction and genuine errors |
| AC-2 | CI-covered: the file no longer skips under `NEO_TEST_SKIP_CI`; local `CI=1 NEO_TEST_SKIP_CI=1` invocation also executes all eight |
| AC-3 | CI-covered: `core/BaseTimeout.spec.mjs` and `core/VdomDestroyCancellation.spec.mjs`; no runtime file changed |

None substantive. `agent-preflight` is not hosted in Engine; direct unit checks and repository hooks ran, and shared CI owns the baseline jobs.
